name: Return
source:
Main character is an ordinary graduate student. One day is called by a professor to test space transfer invention. As a result, protagonist is teleported to another world where he has to earn living as escort hunter while having to deal with a lot of girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名普通的研究生。有一天，一位教授打电话来测试空间转移发明。结果，主角被传送到了另一个世界，在那里他必须以护卫猎人的身份谋生，同时还要与很多女孩打交道。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
